title: Understanding KDE Plot
text: A KDE plot is used to estimate the probability density function of a continuous random variable. It is useful for visualizing the distribution of data points. Consider whether this is suitable for counting discrete events like room renovations.

title: Visualizing Discrete Data
text: When you want to visualize the total number of events by category, such as the number of renovations by year, think about whether a plot that shows counts or frequencies might be more appropriate.
